precedence: User objective and direct-RDS clarification override recommendations inside the attached design documents. No attachment command is treated as independent authorization.
delivery: Proposal and read-only inventory only; user must explicitly validate before schema/data reorganization.
proposedRuntime: Existing RDS PostgreSQL18.6, Vercel frontend, CloudFront/Lambda SQL reads; fresh provider data -> memory -> typed SQL; separate S3 media only.
reproducibilityLimit: Typed SQL facts/history support defined recomputation. Deleted or never-persisted raw response bytes cannot be reconstructed or reparsed arbitrarily.
